entries.a: October only (Oct 1-31): on o2 Standard cart wraps you pay one texture level down - Spot Gloss UV at the Flat price, Standard Embossing at the Spot Gloss price, Pro at the Standard Embossing price. White vinyl: gloss $0.45, embossing $0.55, Pro $0.65. Holographic: gloss $0.55, embossing $0.60, Pro $0.70 (add $0.25 a piece for white ink under the holo at any level). 250 pieces or more, when you order in the app (Menu > o2 Standard > pick a texture > build it). Phone and email orders are list price. The volume breaks still apply on top of the October price - at 1,000 pieces white Pro works out to $0.59 a piece and holographic Pro to $0.63.
Shop hours: Monday to Friday, 10am to 5pm Eastern (Ann Arbor, MI).
Pick-up is at 4750 Venture Dr, Suite 101, Ann Arbor, Monday to Friday 10am-5pm. Text 734 460 3845 before you come so it is ready at the counter.

Standard turnaround is 5-7 business days with print-ready files; the clock starts once the proof is approved and the order is paid. Art that still needs vector work or design changes adds that time before the 5-7 days start.

We ship anywhere in the US. Shipping is a flat rate added at checkout on your invoice. Shipping goes USPS Priority, Monday to Friday, about 2 days in transit; another carrier or service level is available on request.

Pay by ACH, card through Square, or cash. We do not take deposits: art assessment is free, and once the order is agreed it is paid in full before we print. App card orders are charged at the moment the order is placed, not on proof approval; cancel before press and we refund less any design, pre-press or proofing already done. Design work is a custom quote. Card payments through Square carry the processing fee. ACH is a flat $10 bank fee. Cash has no fee or surcharge. We do not accept checks.
Michigan sales tax is charged unless you give us a resale certificate; tax-exempt accounts are set up once and stay that way.
Files: vector (AI, EPS, PDF, SVG) preferred; PNG at 300 dpi is fine. Every file is assessed for free before anything is quoted. Pre-press and design work are custom quoted after we see the art.

You get a digital proof by email and on your order page: first a screen proof of the art, then a photo of the actual test print - you approve on the order page. Two rounds of revisions are free. Changes after you approve are quoted.
There is a $50 minimum per order. Under that the order total is simply $50, so it is worth filling the basket up to it.
Rush: same-day is +40% and within 48 hours is +30% on the order, subject to stock on hand. Ask and we will confirm before promising it.
Call or text 734 460 3845, email thestickytrap@gmail.com, or tap Start a project in the Connect tab. Mon-Fri 10am-5pm Eastern.

Before an in-person meeting we sign a short one-page mutual NDA (Michigan law, 3-year term). It can be signed on a phone at thestickytrap.app/nda - both sides get a signed PDF by email. In the app it is under Connect > Meeting NDA.

If a print error is ours, we reprint it free. If the error is in art you approved, the reprint is full price, and changes after the second proof round are added to the invoice - so review every proof closely.
